thread:
maya: Quick UX review — compact playground streaming. main concern: the Stop affordance disappears behind the token meter in narrow layouts. feels like users can't reliably interrupt streaming. alex: yeah noticed this on mobile widths. the stop icon gets tucked under the token pill when the message wraps. jordan: can we make Stop an inline button (left of regen) in compact mode, and collapse token count into a hover/peek instead? maya: proposal: move Stop left, Regen stays on right. token counter becomes a small dot that expands on hover or with a11y keyboard focus. keeps primary controls visible. sam: accessibility nit — if token counter is hover-only, keyboard users lose it. prefer it expand on focus too. also add aria-live for stream chunks so screen readers announce progress when streaming starts/stops. kevin: agree on focus. small copy tweak: change tooltip from "Stop" to "Interrupt generation (Esc)" to surface shortcut. cc @design-bot for copy. design-bot: Suggested copy variations: - "Interrupt generation (Esc)" - "Stop generating" - "Pause / Stop" maya: i like "Interrupt generation (Esc)" — explicit and surfaces shortcut. alex: technical: moving the Stop button left is straightforward but watch animation overlap with token caching indicator. we should debounce the token meter expand to avoid jitter when streaming. jordan: for the token meter behavior, what about a collapsed numeric (e.g., "• 123") that expands to full meter on focus/hover, and we expose an aria-label like "Tokens used: 123"? sam: +1. sample aria snippet for the stream container: ```
Streaming…
• 123 ``` kevin: UX question — when user hits Stop, should we leave partial content as-is or append a small inline banner: "Generation stopped — partial response" with a Retry action? maya: prefer inline banner with Retry. makes it clear state changed. banner should be announced via aria-live. jordan: also flag for analytics: record whether Stop happened before first token, mid-stream, or near end — helps tune when people interrupt. alex: one more microcopy nuance: Regen button label — currently "Regenerate" is long in compact rail. consider icon + short label "Regen" or just icon with accessible label. sam: icon-only is ok if we add visible focus ring and accessible name. keyboard users should be able to tab to it and read the aria-label. kevin: QA checklist for this change: - compact layout: stop button left + regen right verified at 320px - token counter accessible by keyboard and hover - aria-live announcements for stream start/stop - Esc shortcut triggers stop and is documented in tooltip/copy - analytics events for interrupt timing maya: i'll mock this up and push a tiny prototype. tagging @jordan @alex for review once PR is up. anyone want to add quick sketches here? jordan: i'll drop a 1-up in figma by EOD. alex: will check runtime overlap with token cache and add debounce in the client. sam: i'll add voiceover notes and keyboard focus tests to the accessibility spec. kevin: thanks all — feels like a small change but should improve interrupt affordance a lot. :thumbsup: maya: thanks — will follow up with PR link.
